text: A voice in your sleep, awkwardly familiar. A hint that you should investigate this region and make light.

Your spies and scholars find a subtle tread. A former king of Magritta, Eustaquio Sunscryer, disappeared in an expedition into the Land of the Dead, and yet there are rumours of something seething there. Furthermore, you weren't the only one hearing the resonating command.
Occupy, loot, sack or raze three settlements belonging to Tomb Kings.

The expedition is successful, but astonished. You have found Eustaquio. Dead, yet alive. Silenced, yet as arrogant and demanding as his worst depictions. You understand, from his disconcerting and looping explanation, that the local undead punished him for breaking into their sacred monuments, took his still beating heart and dipped the gold he coveted onto his body, till but a golden skeleton remained. \\n\\nThe Cult of Myrmidia is unsure on how to proceed, as Eustaquio seems to be possessed by nothing but himself.
Have at least 5000 in your treasury to fund the completely voluntary but compulsory restoration efforts.
